accepted_change: Recent personal usage bonus (7-day half-life, capped at 32 recent selections) added to retained lifetime counts; opt-in only.

simulated_preference_change.construction: Deterministically choose first 20 ambiguous HK vocabulary codes in sorted order. Existing preference has 10 lifetime selections, alternative has 3 selections at the current time. The recent layer weights the alternative at 12; older preference remains at 10. This is synthetic behavior verification, not measured user accuracy.

observed_corpus_phrase_bonus.training: HKCanCor training conversations only, 13,163 existing phrases with at least 3 observations. Validation/test conversations excluded. 2–8 and 3–8 character phrase bonuses tested at strengths 0.2, 0.4, 0.8.
observed_corpus_phrase_bonus.reason: First-choice accuracy did not improve, held-out MRR declined slightly; retain the existing trained language model and vocabulary scoring.

wider_beam.reason: No first-choice or top-20 improvement on the 120-case validation sample; retain the existing width.

limits: JVM comparisons use the production dictionary/model and scoring callbacks. They do not measure Fold7 typing latency, Android UI behavior or real user preference accuracy; Android instrumentation tests are compiled but not executed in this environment.
